answer: The POAP claim requires a secret word revealed only inside the venue, and the cipher of the design is that the secret is spoken aloud by the host and never published online. The willow of the scheme is that the secret changes per event, so last year's word is useless. A Sybil cannot claim the POAP from a recording, because the secret is only useful during the event window, and the wander of the reveal is tied to being there when it happens.
